candidates.description: This feature activates on terms related to historical fascism, specifically the Nazi regime and Holocaust, along with European surnames and cultural proper nouns.
This feature vector represents German-language morphological suffixes, words, and proper nouns related to German culture and geography.
This vector is related to common German given names and historical terms.
This feature vector represents adjectival modifiers that describe the societal, structural, or ideological domain of a noun.
This vector represents words or word fragments starting with the prefix "ant-" or containing the letter sequence "ant".
This feature vector represents common Portuguese words and grammatical particles.
This feature vector represents subword tokens ending with the lowercase letters "-av" or "-ev".
This feature vector activates on prefixes, roots, and fragments of words related to historical events, nationality, and semantics.

This feature vector represents morphological roots, prefixes, and suffixes related to the Latin root *claudere* (meaning "to shut" or "close") and its derivatives involving inclusion, exclusion, and declaration.
These tokens represent adverbial and nominal suffixes in Romance languages, primarily forming adverbs ending in "-ly" and abstract nouns.
